sentences.text: Hi everyone. Thanks for joining us today.
Hi, good to see you.
Hi, can you hear me?
Sometimes this mic doesn’t work.
Yeah, we can hear you Archie, Right.
There’s a lot to get through.
Archie, can you take notes?
OK, yep. First, we need to have a chat about Live, Study, Cook and we will need to talk about what's going on with William Puddle.
Ah yes, things aren’t going well with William, I hear.
Hmm, I’m afraid not.
Let’s talk about Liv's Study, Cook first though.
Sure. First, the filming schedule, The big news is that we’ve got the money for ten different episodes.
Ten episodes? Great!
I thought we could only have eight.
No, that’s been changed to ten.
We checked with the finance department.
And when will that start?
Well, we were hoping to start filming in July, but we all know that with the summer holidays, that’s just not going to happen, so we’ve pushed it back until October.
October, good idea.
It’ll be much more comfortable then.
Alright. and what about the food?
Have you decided on what kind of food they should cook for the Live, Study, Cook competition for this series?
Ok, well, first we thought about breakfast foods, but they’re probably too easy, so we're now going with main dishes.
Main dishes, ok.
So, things you would have for lunch and dinner.
Right, yeah, Things like soup, chicken, roast vegetables.
The other option, which I’m sure will be very popular, is desserts.
Desserts! Great! Mmm, yes.
Cakes, ice cream, biscuits.
gets anything sweet.
That sounds wonderful.
Alright, let’s move on.
Alright, let’s talk about this viral video with William Puddle then.
Can you tell me what the problems were?
it’s all here in this tabloid story.
Flood. in the kitchen.
A flood. Really?
Yeah, I’m afraid so.
A real flood.
And there was some possible food safety issues, but we think it’s all been a misunderstanding, And this is our star chef, William?
Oh, this is not good news.
We've just signed off on a huge budget for his new show.
Oh dear. People are also saying he was very upset in the video, right?
He wasn’t upset he was chopping onions!
That’s why he was crying.
The whole video was about cooking with onions!
And look, my name is right there at the bottom!
Oh, this is embarrassing.
This is not good.
Not good at all.
Uh, can I make a suggestion?
Um, I think all staff should be asked to go on a social media training course.
Hmm. OK. So what would that involve?
Well, we would need to find a course all about behaving properly online, and saying things so that people don’t misinterpret what you’re saying.
Show how not to offend people.
That kind of thing?
Exactly. Right, well I could include that in my all staff emails this week.
But I think we need to sweeten the deal to keep everybody happy.
Any ideas? Over time pay?
I’m afraid not.
Too expensive. How about, an extra day of leave?
An extra day off work?
Hmm. OK, but not for everyone.
I know: a day off work, but only if they do three courses.
Yes, that’s good: they have to do three courses, and only the first ten people to complete all three can get an extra day off.
Great idea! Narrow it down to ten.
Create a bit of a competitive spirit!
anything else we need to discuss?
Yes, there were some issues at Golden Sun Tower.
We need to do something about the little fire problem that we had the last time we used the private kitchen there.
the little fire problem.
Excuse me, a fire?
Why am I only hearing about this now?
First a flood and now a fire.
Well, you see, it wasn’t really a fire.
It was just a piece of burnt toast.
Our chefs burnt the toast?
Well, that’s embarrassing!
yes, it is.
We’ve had a complaint from the owner of the private kitchen.
They said that our staff didn’t know what to do when they started the fire, Well that’s not good.
I mean, as I said before, it wasn’t a real fire.
Well then, I think our chefs will need to do some fire safety training, don’t you?
Absolutely. We'll. we'll work out a schedule.
Ok, fire safety training for chefs.
Uh, there’s another problem regarding costs.
Go on. The private kitchen wants money to cover their cost, as they can’t serve diners when we're filming.
How much do they want?
That’s absurd! Absolutely not.
Five ,000. They can take it or leave it.
So, five ,000 for the private kitchen.
I’ll make a note of that.
Now, something a bit happier.
I have some news about the new show.
It’s with William, but it will still be amazing.
It’s called Viewer’s Choice what’s so amazing about it?
Well, because it’s interactive.
Viewers can actually choose their own ingredients and decide what William cooks right there on the show, It'll be the first ever fully interactive online TV cooking show!
Interactive? How on Earth will that work?
don’t worry, we'll send you the details.
There’s a storyboard, and I've added some updates.
Is any of it recorded?
No, it’s totally live, and it’s going to change the face of TV cooking forever!
And it’s live?
But so many things could go wrong!
We can’t let William ruin his career again!
Ah, but think of how many things could go right!
It’s a guaranteed winner!
